searchQuery.description: The current search query string entered by the user.

searchActive.description: Whether the search input is currently focused or has a non-empty query.

filters.description:
Array of available filter descriptors. Each entry defines a filterable dimension:
  - field: string (the schema field to filter on)
  - label: string (display label)
  - type: "select" | "multi-select" | "range" | "boolean" | "date-range"
  - options: array of { value, label } for select/multi-select types

activeFilters.description:
Array of currently applied filter values:
  - field: string (matches a filter descriptor field)
  - operator: "eq" | "in" | "range" | "gt" | "lt" | "between"
  - value: unknown (the selected filter value or values)

filterCount.description: Computed count of currently active filters.

pageSize.description: Number of items displayed per page.

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages. Used to compute total page count.

totalPages.description: Computed total number of pages (ceil(totalItems / pageSize)).

result_state.description: What the engine concluded: violation on every finding of this run, because Stage1 writes needs-review, passed and not-applicable only as page counts.

provenance_source.description: The system that produced the record.

provenance_locator.description: Where in that record the values were read.

finding_id.description: The page route and the rule, "<route>#<rule_id>": one rule failing on one page is one finding.

examples: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
ARIA role should be appropriate for the element
Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
Table header text should not be empty
title.description: The rule's one-line statement of what must hold (axe `help`), which names the finding.

examples: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role
Ensure role attribute has an appropriate value for the element
Ensure table headers have discernible text
description.description: What the rule checks, in the engine's words.

impact.description: The engine's impact for the rule. Stage1 keeps an unknown bucket beside axe's four.

route.description: The page the finding is on, as a route.

node_count.description: How many elements on the page fail the rule.

examples: iframe[title="A look at beta Web Components"]
iframe[title="A look at beta Web Components"]
iframe[title="A look at beta Web Components"]
selectors.description: The failing elements, as the engine's selectors.

criteria.description: The rule's tags: WCAG criteria, best-practice and the standards it maps to.

help_url.description: The engine's page for the rule.
